fusions.name: Gaining Ground
fusions.desc: Throws a curved blade at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Column Right
fusions.desc: Sweeps a full circle that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. When it hits, your allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Mower's Stride
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds and your movement speed by 25% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hedgerow Pickings
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
